description.value:
For the duration, when you Sense Motive to detect a lie or notice a deception, you may use 15 as your Perception check result if your roll is lower than 15; this is a fortune effect.

In addition, while this spell is active you cannot be magically compelled or enchanted into believing false information you have already consciously identified as false during the duration.

Heightened (6th) The minimum Perception result for Sense Motive checks increases to 20, and you also gain the same minimum result on Diplomacy checks to read emotions and Deception checks to recognize that someone else is using Deception.
